promise: Government-funded breakfast and lunch programmes in all decile 1 and 2 schools ('Feed the Kids' bill)
detail: Hone Harawira's Education (Breakfast and Lunch Programmes in Schools) Amendment Bill was drawn from the member's ballot on 8 November 2012 but did not become law while Mana held its seat; Mana left Parliament in 2014. (Mana was in opposition and could not pass it alone.)

promise: Stop the sale of state-owned energy companies
detail: Outcome not achieved: the National-led government's mixed-ownership sell-downs of Genesis, Meridian and Mighty River Power went ahead. Mana was in opposition.

promise: Internet Party–Mana memorandum: Mana to hold list places 1, 3 and 4 and the parties to review the arrangement within five weeks of the election
detail: List ordered as agreed; after reviews the alliance was dissolved on 13 December 2014.

promise: Memorandum with the Māori Party: Mana not to contest other Māori electorates in exchange for a clear run in Te Tai Tokerau
detail: Mana stood only in Te Tai Tokerau and Māngere; Harawira lost Te Tai Tokerau to Kelvin Davis 12,673 to 7,866.
